text:
Hannah Li: opened PR to add Aurora-mini-6B model card updates: supported variants, a compact limits table, and a corrected Python streaming snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1024
Marco Ruiz: nice. Quick ask: call out the small vs longctx variants (6k vs 24k) up front; customers keep confusing the names.
Hannah Li: added a one-line callout in the overview and a short table row listing both max_contexts.
Eliot: SDK snippet still uses old param name `max_tokens`. Update to `max_length` and include streaming example pattern to avoid truncation.
Hannah Li: updated snippet to `client.generate_stream(..., max_length=512)` and added a tiny chunking recommendation.
Samira (docs-bot): running linkcheck/spellcheck on branch hannah/aurora-mini-card.
Samira (docs-bot): linkcheck: 1 broken anchor (bench-results). Suggest link to /internals/benchmarks#aurora-mini-6b.
Hannah Li: fixed the bench link and added "(benchmarks on p4d, runtime v1.13)" with TODO INF-2042 to re-run on v1.14.
Marco Ruiz: also add compat note for quant variant: "aurora-mini-quant may fall back to aurora-mini-fp16 when kernels unavailable; performance may vary past ~12k tokens."
Hannah Li: added compat row and a short recommendation: "Use aurora-mini-fp16 for sustained long-context workloads."
Priya Nair: small nit on wording in the limits table, but non-blocking.
Hannah Li: pushed final fixes. Pinged docs-team for review.
